spans.s:
mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं)
1 A kind of elephant or wood apple. नीलकपित्थ.
2

A spade or hoe.
m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A hatchet or stone cutter's chisel.
2 A sword, a scimitar, a sacrificial hatchet or knife.
3 A scabbard, a sword-sheath.
4 Anger, wrath.
5 A weight (of silver) equal to four māṣas.
6 A coin.
7 Pride, arrogance.
8 A cleft, a chasm.
9 A peak.
f. (-ङ्गा)
1 The leg.
2 The edge or side of a mountain.
E.
टकि to bind, affix अच्; or ट imitative, कै to emit sound, affix ड, and नुम् augment.

m. (-कः)
A stamped coin, especially of silver.
E.
कन् added to टङ्क a weight of silver.

m. (-तिः)
The master of a mint or superintendent of the silver coin.
E.
टङ्कक, and पति master.

f. (-ला)
A mint.
E.
टङ्कक, and शाला a hall.

m. (-कः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
टङ्क an axe, and टीक who has, from टीक to go or get, affix अच्.

Binding, tying.
E.
टङ्क to bind, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-तिः)
The master of the mint.
E.
टङ्क a weight of silver put for a coin, and पति master.

f. (-ला)
A mint.
E.
टङ्क see the last, and शाला a house or hall.

m. (-रः)
1 Surprise, wonder.
2 Fame, notoriety.
3 The twang of a bow string.
E.
टकि to bind, &c. affix आरक्; or ट twang, in the second case, कृ to make, affix अण्.

m. (-रः)
A blackguard, a lecher, a libertine.
E.
टां an oath, and कर who takes.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A spade or hoe.
2 An axe.
3 The leg.
4

A weight of four māṣas.
E.
टकि to bind, affix अच्, क changed to गः otherwise टङ्क as above; also with ल्युट् affix, टङ्गन n. (-नं)
